@sketch
Feature: New sketch

  @acceptance @documented_observation
  Scenario: new-sketch-01 Create a sketch on a named origin plane
    Given Part2 has Sketch1 and the Origin browser is expanded
    When the user invoke Start 2D Sketch and choose XZ Plane
    Then Sketch2 is added in the Sketch editing environment
    And the ViewCube reads TOP
    And the empty sketch status reads Fully Constrained

  @cancel @documented_observation
  Scenario: new-sketch-02 Cancel before selecting a plane
    Given Part2 has only Sketch1
    When the user invoke Start 2D Sketch and press Escape before choosing a plane
    Then the reference-plane previews disappear
    And the browser still contains only Sketch1

  @documented_observation @escape_after_acceptance
  Scenario: new-sketch-03 Escape after accepting the support plane
    Given selecting XZ Plane has created empty Sketch2
    When the user press Escape
    Then Sketch2 remains active in the Sketch editing environment
    And creation is not rolled back

  @documented_observation @needs_fixture @undo_redo
  Scenario: new-sketch-04 Creation and finishing have distinct history transactions
    Given the user have created empty Sketch2 and chosen Finish Sketch
    When the user press Ctrl+Z once
    Then Sketch2 remains and its editing environment returns
    When the user press Ctrl+Z again
    Then Sketch2 disappears from the model browser
    When the user press Ctrl+Y twice in sequence
    Then creation and Finish Sketch are restored in order

  @documented_observation @preselection
  Scenario: new-sketch-05 Start with a preselected support plane
    Given the model browser exposes YZ Plane
    When the user select YZ Plane before invoking Start 2D Sketch
    Then Sketch3 is created without another support-selection click
    And the ViewCube reads RIGHT
    And the empty sketch status reads Fully Constrained

  @documented_observation @needs_fixture @planar_face
  Scenario: new-sketch-07 Create an empty sketch on a planar solid face
    Given isolated Part3 contains a 10 mm rectangular extrusion
    When the user invoke Start 2D Sketch and select its broad planar face
    Then Sketch2 is added in the Sketch editing environment
    And FRONT view and empty Fully Constrained status are displayed
    When the user choose Finish Sketch
    Then Sketch2 is retained beside Extrusion1

  @documented_observation @work_plane
  Scenario: new-sketch-08 Create a sketch on a non-origin work plane
    Given Work Plane1 was created 5 mm offset from the planar face
    When the user preselect Work Plane1 and invoke Start 2D Sketch
    Then empty Sketch3 is created without another support click
    And Finish Sketch retains Sketch3 and Work Plane1

  @automatic_startup @documented_observation @needs_fixture
  Scenario: new-sketch-09 Observe each automatic startup plane and restore the baseline
    Given No new sketch is the starting preference
    When the user accept each automatic startup plane in turn
    And the user create a fresh metric part document after each change
    Then x-y creates Part4 Sketch1 in FRONT view
    And y-z creates Part5 Sketch1 in RIGHT view
    And x-z creates Part6 Sketch1 in TOP orientation
    And no separate Start 2D Sketch action is needed in those routes
    And No new sketch is restored accepted and verified

  @documented_observation @look_at
  Scenario: new-sketch-10 Compare automatic normal view on creation and edit
    Given Part6 is in an oblique Home View
    When the user disable Part Look at sketch plane and create a sketch on YZ Plane
    Then Sketch2 is created and the oblique view remains
    When the user finish Sketch2 and restore Part Look at sketch plane
    And the user choose Edit Sketch on that same Sketch2
    Then its editing environment opens in RIGHT view

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: new-sketch-06 Save close and reopen an accumulated sketch document
    Given Part1 contains an existing sketch with geometry
    When the user finish Sketch3 and save Part1
    And the user close the document using its document Close button
    Then the MCAD Software Home is shown without a save prompt
    When the user open Part1 from Documents using the file picker
    Then the saved model browser and geometry load
    When the user choose Edit Sketch on Sketch3
    Then the Sketch ribbon and editable geometry are available
    And the rectangular and circular pattern entries remain in Sketch3

scenarios.scenario: new-sketch-10 Compare automatic normal view on creation and edit
